name: Lvgl → Widget Set Z Index
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#actions-action) changes the stacking order (z-index) of a widget among its siblings, i.e. which widgets are drawn on top of which. It does not change any other widget property.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID or a list of IDs of widgets configured in LVGL to reorder.

config_entries.label: Position
config_entries.description: One of `top`, `bottom`, `up`, `down`, or an integer sibling index.
